prompt: Follow the Architecture-First Engineering Doctrine. First inspect the existing marketplace, opportunity_auction, Revenue Exchange, buyer allocation and capacity contracts. Record a bounded architecture delta in docs/architecture/marketplace_auction_readiness_v1.md, then implement a canonical read-only marketplace/auction readiness model in empire_os/marketplace_auction_readiness.py with focused tests. Reuse existing canonical components; do not create a second marketplace or settlement path. The readiness model must expose inventory, buyer eligibility/capacity, bid/price evidence, auction/clearing readiness, allocation readiness, blockers and evidence refs. Unknown stays unknown. No bid execution, allocation execution, pricing mutation, terms, payment, settlement, outbound or revenue-recognition authority.
